response: The distribution of health care benefits in Kenya does not meet the principles of universal coverage. According to the principles of universal coverage, all individuals should benefit from health care according to their needs. However, the Kenyan health sector is currently inequitable, and benefits are not distributed based on need. To achieve universal coverage, deliberate efforts are necessary to restructure the Kenyan health system and address access barriers, ensuring that all Kenyans receive health care when they need it.
